_comment: Approval contract snapshot, generated from the codex binary itself:
(45 files + a v1/ and a v2/ subdirectory)
Excerpted for S3 slice 4 (permission projection): the decision dialects, the
approval request params, and the full server-request method list.
FIDELITY, per block: `serverRequestMethods` is a derived list (see its own
_source). Every *Decision `oneOf` and every entry under `requestParams` is
VERBATIM, descriptions included — rev.1 of this file reduced the request
properties to bare type names, which silently hid that fileChange.grantRoot
asks for session-long write access under a root. Do not reduce them again:
the descriptions ARE the security semantics.
This is a COMMITTED STATIC SNAPSHOT. It does not discover drift by itself:
when codex is upgraded the command above MUST be re-run and this file rebuilt,
or "pinned" only means pinned to a world that no longer exists.

serverRequestMethods._source: ServerRequest.json (top-level oneOf, properties.method.enum[0] of each variant)
serverRequestMethods._note: ELEVEN variants. codex-method-contract.json lists ten and is wrong in both directions: it invents "openai/form" (that string is the `mode` enum inside McpServerElicitationRequestParams, never a method) and omits applyPatchApproval / execCommandApproval.

CommandExecutionApprovalDecision._note: SIX variants, not the four the S2 design assumed. The two object variants persist a rule and are not modelled this round.

oneOf.description: User approved the command and future prompts in the same session-scoped approval cache should run without prompting.
User approved the command, and wants to apply the proposed execpolicy amendment so future matching commands can run without prompting.
oneOf.title: AcceptWithExecpolicyAmendmentCommandExecutionApprovalDecision

oneOf.description: User chose a persistent network policy rule (allow/deny) for this host.
oneOf.title: ApplyNetworkPolicyAmendmentCommandExecutionApprovalDecision

oneOf.description: User denied the command. The agent will continue the turn.
User denied the command. The turn will also be immediately interrupted.

FileChangeApprovalDecision._note: FOUR string variants, no object variants: the file_change dialect is NOT identical to the exec one.

oneOf.description: User approved the file changes and future changes to the same files should run without prompting.
User denied the file changes. The agent will continue the turn.
User denied the file changes. The turn will also be immediately interrupted.

ReviewDecision._note: The legacy dialect, used by applyPatchApproval / execCommandApproval. Reachable on this wire per ServerRequest.json, never observed in any recorded frame. Not registered in SERVER_REQUEST_KINDS this round (slice 4 spec L5).

oneOf.description: User has approved this command and the agent should execute it.
User has approved this command and wants to apply the proposed execpolicy amendment so future matching commands are permitted.
oneOf.title: ApprovedExecpolicyAmendmentReviewDecision

oneOf.description: User has approved this request and wants future prompts in the same session-scoped approval cache to be automatically approved for the remainder of the session.
User chose to persist a network policy rule (allow/deny) for future requests to the same host.
oneOf.title: NetworkPolicyAmendmentReviewDecision

oneOf.description: User has denied this command and the agent should not execute it, but it should continue the session and try something else.
oneOf.title: DeniedReviewDecision

oneOf.description: Automatic approval review timed out before reaching a decision.
User has denied this command and the agent should not do anything until the user's next command.

PermissionsRequestApprovalResponse._source: PermissionsRequestApprovalResponse.json (top level; GrantedPermissionProfile has no required members)
PermissionsRequestApprovalResponse._note: Confirms codexPending's fail-safe body {permissions:{}, scope:'turn'} is contract-legal.

requestParams._source: {CommandExecutionRequestApproval,FileChangeRequestApproval,PermissionsRequestApproval,ApplyPatchApproval,ExecCommandApproval}Params.json — `required` and `properties` copied VERBATIM (descriptions included). Nested $ref definitions are kept only for the two shapes slice 4 renders (NetworkApprovalContext, AdditionalPermissionProfile); the rest stay as $ref names pointing back at the generated files.
requestParams._note: fileChange carries NO diff and NO availableDecisions: the patch arrives on the item/started frame sharing its itemId. Read grantRoot / additionalPermissions / networkApprovalContext before designing any approval UI — each one widens what an Allow actually grants.

additionalPermissions.description: Optional additional permissions requested for this command.

approvalId.description:
Unique identifier for this specific approval callback.

For regular shell/unified_exec approvals, this is null.

For zsh-exec-bridge subcommand approvals, multiple callbacks can belong to one parent `itemId`, so `approvalId` is a distinct opaque callback id (a UUID) used to disambiguate routing.

availableDecisions.description: Ordered list of decisions the client may present for this prompt.

commandActions.description: Best-effort parsed command actions for friendly display.

environmentId.description: Environment in which the command will run.

networkApprovalContext.description: Optional context for a managed-network approval prompt.

proposedExecpolicyAmendment.description: Optional proposed execpolicy amendment to allow similar commands without prompting.

proposedNetworkPolicyAmendments.description: Optional proposed network policy amendments (allow/deny host) for future requests.

reason.description: Optional explanatory reason (e.g. request for network access).

startedAtMs.description: Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) when this approval request started.

network.description: Partial overlay used for per-command permission requests.

grantRoot.description: [UNSTABLE] When set, the agent is asking the user to allow writes under this root for the remainder of the session (unclear if this is honored today).

reason.description: Optional explanatory reason (e.g. request for extra write access).
